artwork.cornerNote: Original art  •  A more beautiful everyday
artwork.storyBody: Each layer is built by hand over several weeks — texture paste pressed into organic ridges, then washed with thin acrylic glazes until the surface holds light the way a real leaf does. The gold is applied last, leaf by leaf, following the veins the texture created on its own.

about.title: About the Artist — Mariam
about.description: Mariam is a visual artist working in botanical mixed media, oil and graphite. Read about her process, materials and studio.
about.eyebrow: A life inspired by nature, art and meaning
about.body: I'm Mariam, a visual artist and the heart behind Mariam-Art. I create hand-painted pieces that bring together nature, emotion, and a sense of timeless beauty. Through texture, light, and delicate details, I aim to capture the quiet moments that make life meaningful — and turn them into art for your space.
about.quote: Nature is my greatest source of inspiration. In its textures, contrasts and quiet details, I find endless stories to tell.
about.processKicker: From inspiration to a timeless piece
about.processBody: Each artwork is a journey — from a moment of inspiration to a finished piece that carries emotion, texture and a story of its own.
about.step1Body: Nature, everyday moments, and the beauty in imperfection spark my ideas.
about.step2Body: I translate emotions and natural forms into sketches, exploring composition and flow.
about.step3Body: Layer by layer, I build texture and depth, letting the piece evolve naturally on canvas.
about.step4Body: Every detail is carefully refined, completing a piece that's ready to bring beauty and meaning into your home.
about.studioBody: A quiet room with north light, too many brushes and a long table that is never quite clear.
